svg.aria-label: Wiring diagram of the voice satellite. A USB 5 volt supply powers an ESP32 dev board over its USB socket. On the left an INMP441 I2S microphone connects to the ESP32: SD to GPIO32 driven by the microphone, WS to GPIO25 and SCK to GPIO33 driven by the ESP32, VDD to the 3.3 volt pin, GND to ground, and L slash R tied to the same ground to select the left channel. On the right, GPIO4 goes through a 470 ohm series resistor to the DIN pad of an 8 LED WS2812B stick cut from the spare reel; the stick's plus 5V pad takes USB 5 volts from the ESP32's VIN or 5V pin, and its GND pad joins the ESP32 ground. No level shifter and no bulk capacitor are fitted. A dashed box marks a future MAX98357A amplifier and speaker that is not part of this build.
svg.title: Voice satellite wiring (ESP32 + INMP441 + 8 WS2812B)
